relevance_note: Case report of two LAMP2 carriers, a mother and son: 'we describe a mother and her son affected by DD'.
method_note: Read the whole paper and wrote values by hand into a Python builder script (no automated table transcription). Table 1 and Table 2 have patients as columns; column headers are 'Case 1' and 'Case 2'. Individual labels use the paper's own labels 'Case 1' and 'Case 2'. The 'familiar history of four SCD' and the extended pedigree (Figure 3) linking to families of Echaniz-Laguna et al. [13] and Muntoni et al. [14] give no individual-level facts, so no rows for those relatives; first-degree relatives refused cascade screening and are not described. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null: the paper says the variant and the extended family were previously reported (refs 13, 14) but does not state that Case 1 or Case 2 themselves were described before. Case 1's parents were not tested ('A cascade clinical and genetic screening was proposed to her first-degree family members but initially refused'), so inheritance not reported. Laboratory values (CPK 73 vs 1254 UI/L; AST–ALT 80–52 vs 592–373 UI/L) are printed without reference ranges or an interpretation, so elevated CK and elevated liver enzymes are left not reported. Table 2 'No' entries (Ocular, Musculoskeletal) were taken as explicit absences for Case 1, which exclude the narrower checklist items myopia, retinopathy and skeletal myopathy. Case 2 'Asymptomatic myopathy' recorded as skeletal myopathy observed. Case 2 chorioretinitis not mapped to pigmentary retinopathy. Case 2 'VF/arrest: No' does not exclude ventricular tachycardia, so that checklist item is not reported. Cardiac MRI was not performed, so LGE is not reported. Variant type 'frameshift' and 'pathogenic' come from the sentence naming this exact variant; Case 2 also 'inherited the pathogenic variant from his mother'. Study type: the title says 'a case report' while the abstract says 'In this case series'; recorded as case report. No contradictions inside the paper found; no stacked cells.
